Rewards

Rewards you agree on in advance

It does not have to be a purchase. A film, board game, walk, or 20 minutes together can all be rewards.

You make the list

There is no built-in shop, only options you are ready to offer.

Your child sees what remains

If a reward needs 8 more coins, that is clear immediately.

Parents have the final say

Even when there are enough coins, you choose the right moment.

Try the full family workspace

Explore a temporary interactive workspace with tasks, coins, rewards, requests, family settings, and a child view — or sign in to open your own shop.
